item.description: ### Fixed - **OpenCode works when its folders are moved in your shell's startup file.** If your `.zshrc` or `.zprofile` sets `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`, `XDG_STATE_HOME`, `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`, `OPENCODE_DATA_DIR` or `OPENCODE_DB`, OpenCode used those folders but Perch didn't know. So Perch's plugin could be installed where OpenCode never looks, its sessions database could go unfound, and OpenCode 2 sessions could be missing entirely. Perch now asks your login shell for those six settings once at launch, and only those. Anything your startup file prints is ignored. A setting given for one terminal session only, such as `XDG_DATA_HOME=… opencode`, still isn't seen.
